# Representative Instances

Twelve cases per replicate are selected deterministically: closest to group F40 median, highest true M4 CE, smallest group F40-NN distance, and largest distance from group median. The Original extra montage uses the four largest replacement niches and selects the within-group median-hardness case. No case was hand-picked for narrative agreement.
